meta.title: OctoTechnology — kind apps for children aged 2–7
meta.desc: OctoTechnology makes stories, learning games, coloring pages and trucks with Mark the Cat for children aged 2–7. No ads, no losing, safe for kids.
hero.title: Kind apps where little ones learn through play
hero.sub: OctoTechnology makes apps for children aged 2–7 for Android, iPhone and iPad: stories, games, coloring pages and trucks with Mark the Cat. No ads and no losing — just joy and a little learning every day.

shelf.lead: Every app is like a little book with its own adventure. Tap a book to open it.

apps.lead: What's inside, who it is for and where to find it.
mark.title: Meet Mark the Cat 🐱
mark.lead: A ginger cat in round glasses is a kind grown-up friend for little ones. He never tests or scolds — he asks for help, shows the way when your child is unsure and celebrates every success.
mark.motto: “You can do it — Mark is right here.”
mark.r1d: Reads stories and shows new words in TwoMeows
mark.r2d: Builds and washes trucks in Mark's Garage
mark.r3d: Flies in on a balloon in Mark the Cat
mark.r4d: Brings pictures to life in Mark's Art
mark.r5d: Tidies up with your child in Mark's Home
parents.title: Made with care for parents 👨‍👩‍👧
parents.lead: The same promises work in every app of the family.
parents.c1d: A wrong move just gently bounces back. No red, no error sounds, no timers.
parents.c2d: No ads and no links to other sites — only the game and learning.
parents.c3d: Our games collect as little data as possible, and most collect none at all. Every policy is public.
parents.c4d: Settings and purchases sit behind a gate that little hands can't open.
parents.c5d: Play on the road, at the cottage or on a plane.
parents.c6d: Mark speaks up to 17 languages, and children don't need to read.
kids.title: And for kids it's just play ⭐
kids.lead: Every task ends with a celebration and a little gift.
kids.f1: 🎈 Balloons, confetti and parties after every task
kids.f2: 🗣️ Mark's warm voice explains everything simply
kids.f3: 👆 Big buttons and easy gestures for little fingers
kids.f4: 🎁 Gifts, stickers and pictures that come alive
studio.title: About the studio 🐙
studio.lead: OctoTechnology is a small independent studio. Like an octopus, we have many hands — and each one makes a new app for children.
studio.p1: We start every game by watching how children really play, and we only keep what a two-year-old can manage on their own. Every app is built for Android and iOS at the same time from one shared code base, so the iPhone and iPad versions grow together with the Android ones.

apps.twomeows.name: TwoMeows
apps.twomeows.tagline: Bilingual audio stories that teach a second language
apps.twomeows.about1: TwoMeows reads stories in Ukrainian and shows new words in Slovak — with a picture, a translation and clear pronunciation. Not a lesson and no cramming: just a story in which the word sticks by itself.
apps.twomeows.about2: Made for children aged 2–7 and their parents — especially for families where Slovak became the language of a new home and Ukrainian stays the language of bedtime stories. Here Mark the Cat is a teacher with round glasses and a bow tie.
apps.twomeows.f1d: 3–5 minute stories read by a professional narrator, with the text highlighted along with the voice.
apps.twomeows.f2d: A new word appears with a picture, a translation and its pronunciation.
apps.twomeows.f3d: After the story the words come back once more — so they stay in memory.
apps.twomeows.f4d: Stickers, power levels and a treasure box of learned words.
apps.twomeows.f5d: Adventures, animals, space, friendship and bedtime stories.
apps.twomeows.f6d: Each child keeps their own progress, favourite stories and rewards.
apps.marks-garage.name: Mark's Garage
apps.marks-garage.tagline: Build a truck, fill it up, do the job and wash it!
apps.marks-garage.about1: Mark the Cat runs a garage, and he really needs a helper! Every truck is a small adventure in the same easy steps: build it, fill it up, do three real jobs, wash it and park it in the garage. Little ones quickly know what comes next — and play on their own.
apps.marks-garage.about2: Mark names every machine and says what it is for, so children learn to recognise real vehicles on the street. 20 construction machines are ready to play, and five more worlds — the city, the farm, the airport, the railway and the seaport — are on their way.
apps.marks-garage.f1d: Parts ride along a conveyor, and your child drags each one into place.
apps.marks-garage.f2d: Three real jobs in three places: dig, pour, lift, flatten the road.
apps.marks-garage.f3d: Mud, foam, brush, wax — and a sparkling clean truck.
apps.marks-garage.f4d: Short films about real big machines and gifts for Mark's workshop.
apps.marks-garage.f5d: No losing, no timers and no “wrong” — only “not yet”.
apps.marks-garage.f6d: Mark's warm voice gives a hint in your child's language.
apps.mark-the-cat.name: Mark the Cat
apps.mark-the-cat.tagline: 30 gentle learning games on a green island
apps.mark-the-cat.about1: Mark the Cat and his little mouse friends invite your child to a green island with 30 gentle learning games: seat the mice in train cars of their colour, stack a ring pyramid, help a baby animal find its mum, bake a pie or put a puzzle together.
apps.mark-the-cat.about2: Every game is a small task in three short rounds. When everything is done, Mark flies in, celebrates with your child, and a party of balloons begins.
apps.mark-the-cat.f1d: Colours, shapes, counting, memory and nimble fingers.
apps.mark-the-cat.f2d: Games open one by one, from the easiest ones for two-year-olds.
apps.mark-the-cat.f3d: Mark flies in on his balloon and celebrates together with your child.
apps.mark-the-cat.f4d: No timers, scores or “wrong” — a helping hand gently shows what to do.
apps.mark-the-cat.f5d: Mark speaks your device's language, so there is nothing to read.
apps.mark-the-cat.f6d: No ads, works offline and collects no data.
apps.mark-the-cat.price: 3 games free, “Unlock all” is a one-time purchase
apps.marks-art.name: Mark's Art
apps.marks-art.about1: Color with Mark the Cat! One tap fills an area with color, and when the picture is finished it comes alive: the train puffs and rolls, the balloon floats away, the rocket takes off, the fish swim.
apps.marks-art.about2: Here Mark is an artist with a red beret, a brush and a palette. Made for children aged 2–5: big friendly buttons and no reading needed.
apps.marks-art.f1d: 8 albums: trains, friends, animals, treats, fairy tales, the island, holidays and space.
apps.marks-art.f2d: Wheels turn, smoke puffs, the sun shines — in your child's own colors.
apps.marks-art.f3d: One-tap fill, brush, glitter, patterns, stickers and an eraser.
apps.marks-art.f4d: Color from memory while Mark names every color.
apps.marks-art.f5d: Mark talks to your child in their language and cheers every picture.
apps.marks-art.f6d: No ads; settings sit behind a simple math question for parents.
apps.marks-home.name: Mark's Home
apps.marks-home.tagline: “I'm big now — I help!” A cosy game about home
apps.marks-home.about1: A new game in the Mark the Cat family — about home. Tasks light up one by one across the room: dust the toy chest, put the toys away, vacuum the floor, make the bed. A tap on a task opens a close-up mini-game.
apps.marks-home.about2: The game is in development right now. Screenshots, videos and store links will appear here soon.
apps.marks-home.f1d: Kids' room, kitchen, living room, bathroom, yard and garage.
apps.marks-home.f2d: Jobs light up one after another; a tap opens the close-up.
apps.marks-home.f3d: Taps, swipes and guiding things with a finger.
apps.marks-home.f4d: Morning, day, evening and bedtime set the order of levels.
apps.marks-home.f5d: Your child sees how the room became clean and cosy.
apps.marks-home.f6d: Mark flies in, says why it helps and gives a reward.
